History Name: The Mistlands Alias: The Shadowfell ​ Mournful but strangely peaceful. It is a land of endless twilight where sorrow softens and memories fade like mist.Races: Dataview: No results to show for table query. Individuals: Dataview: No results to show for table query.Dataview: No results to show for table query. The Shadowfell A mirror of the mortal world, dim and muted, where forests twist into skeletal shapes and rivers run sluggish and dark. Though bleak, it is strangely quiet, a place where the noise of life no longer reaches. All other regions rest hidden within this one; The Perfumed Fields (Summer Court) Gentle meadows blooming with eternal spring, where the souls of poets, lovers, and dreamers wander amidst blossoms. Perfume fills the air, and sorrow is forgotten in the warmth of endless day. The Gleaming Grove (Summer Court) An orchard of silver trees heavy with fruit. The souls of the faithful rest in hammocks woven of silk, feasting without hunger and sleeping without fear. The Black Glacier (Winter Court) A harsh and empty expanse of frozen stone. Here, the lost souls who resisted joy are trapped, frozen in silence beneath the ice. The Withered Hollow (Winter Court) A skeletal forest of dead oaks, their branches groaning like voices. Those who were cruel or selfish wander here in endless gloom, unable to escape their shadows.

History Name: The Primal Maelstrom Alias: The Elemental Chaos ​ Wild, vast, and perilous... but also wondrous. It is a realm of both destruction and genesis, where untamed beauty collides in constant transformation. Mortals who enter often find themselves lost in its splendor, unable to tell whether they walk through paradise or ruin.Races: Dataview: No results to show for table query. Individuals: Dataview: No results to show for table query.Dataview: No results to show for table query. The Sea Without Shore A boundless ocean stretching in every direction, its waves rising like mountains and crashing down with thunder. The waters shimmer in impossible colors beneath a sky heavy with salt winds. Ruling Kingdom: Thalassara, the Drowned Court - a palace of coral and pearl that drifts between currents, ruled by the Tide-King and his court of storm-eyed sirens. The Everflame Peaks Mountains of burning stone that bleed rivers of molten fire into valleys below. The air here is heavy with ash, yet every ember sings with living voices. Ruling Kingdom: Pyrrithane, the Ashen Throne - a fortress of obsidian and brass rising from a caldera, where the Flame-Queen presides with her blazing host. The Sky of Endless Breath An open expanse where clouds tower like continents and storms bloom with sudden fury. Winds carve vast currents, carrying islands of mist and floating crystal. Ruling Kingdom: Aeralith, the Gale Spire - a citadel of silver and glass suspended in storm, ruled by the Wind-Prince and his ever-shifting court. The Rooted Expanse An unbroken plain of living stone, where forests of crystal grow and mountains stride like beasts. Caverns yawn beneath, glowing with veins of gems and echoing with the heartbeat of the world. Ruling Kingdom: Terranova, the Stone Crown - a labyrinthine stronghold carved into the earth’s marrow, ruled by the Earth-Mother and her council of granite giants.

info_showOrphanNodes.description: Show nodes that are not connected to any other nodes.

info_showAttachments.description: Show attachments like images and PDFs as nodes in the graph.

info_allowGlobalGraph.description: Allow the user to view the global graph of all nodes.

info_allowExpand.description: Allow the user to pop-out the graph view to take up the whole screen

info_attractionForce.description: How much should linked nodes attract each other? This will make the graph appear more clustered.

info_linkLength.description: How long should the links between nodes be? The shorter the links the more connected nodes will cluster together.

info_repulsionForce.description: How much should nodes repel each other? This will make disconnected parts more spread out.

info_centralForce.description: How much should nodes be attracted to the center? This will make the graph appear more dense and circular.

info_edgePruning.description: Edges with a length above this threshold will not be rendered, however they will still contribute to the simulation. This can help large tangled graphs look more organised. Hovering over a node will still display these links.

info_minNodeRadius.description: How small should the smallest nodes be? The smaller a node is the less it will attract other nodes.

info_maxNodeRadius.description: How large should the largest nodes be? Nodes are sized by how many links they have. The larger a node is the more it will attract other nodes. This can be used to create a good grouping around the most important nodes.
